podcast.title: Predecessor to Eurythmics
podcast.body: After The Tourists split and the romantic relationship between Dave Stewart and Annie Lennox ended, they reformed as a duo called Eurythmics, leaning more heavily into a synth-driven sound. "After the Taurus split, Stewart and Linux, now broken up as a romantic couple, reformed as a duo, and leaned more heavily into a synth-driven sound."

podcast.title: Romantic Couple Led Band
podcast.body: The Tourists were originally a five-person group led by a romantic couple, guitarist and producer Dave Stewart, and vocalist Annie Lennox. "The then-five-person group was led by a romantic couple, guitarist and producer Dave Stewart, and a potent vocalist named Annie Linux."
